summary: Phase L (iteration 25) complete — all four render/UI-layer features tested and verified: Juveniles (L1), Seed Picker (L2), Live Portraits (L3), and Creature Voices (L4). Backend regression passed. All Playwright acceptance suites passed.
passed_tests: Backend API regression: 11/11 tests passed (GET/POST/GET-by-id/PUT/DELETE /api/saves with X-Player-Token scoping)
L1 Juveniles: 14/14 checks passed - derived sheets (cub/young) with big-head/stubby-leg proportions, inspect panel portraits use correct stage, adult sheets untouched
L2 Seed Picker: 13/13 checks passed - WORLD SEED field with Random/Copy buttons, HUD seed chip, deterministic terrain replay, save/load persistence
L3 Live Portraits: 9/9 checks passed - Species Database portraits animate idle/blink loop, shared rAF ticker (window.__portraitLive), IntersectionObserver pausing, prefers-reduced-motion support

L4 Creature Voices: 12/12 checks passed - WebAudio synthesized snarl/bellow/keen/chirp on threat/lunge, distance attenuation, rate limiting (2.6s per animal, 320ms global gap, 3 voices/2s), mute support, debug counters
Ops Deck regression: 26/26 checks passed - dock/drawer shell, HUD routing, canvas interactivity, legacy fallback
ART_V2 regression: 9/9 checks passed - cel-shading, rim lighting, halo glow, terrain textures

L1_juveniles.sheet_derivation: All 19 species derive cub/young sheets without mutating adult frames
L1_juveniles.proportions: Cub silhouettes shorter with head-mass share >= 1.1x adult for all eyed species
L1_juveniles.eye_remapping: Per-frame eye rects preserved and remapped onto solid pixels
L1_juveniles.blink_frames: Cub blink frames differ from idle only around remapped eyes
L1_juveniles.ingame_render: Juvenile creatures render correctly with inspect panel portrait using cub sheet (data-stage='cub')
L1_juveniles.art_v2_compatibility: Adult sheets with ART_V2 off still match recorded baseline

L2_seed_picker.menu_field: WORLD SEED field with blank→RANDOM hint, numeric/phrase→CODE hint, Random button (9 digits), Copy button
L2_seed_picker.determinism: Same seed replays identical terrain (heights/materials/water/veg hash), different seeds differ
L2_seed_picker.phrase_seeds: Phrase seeds hash deterministically (case-insensitive) via FNV-1a
L2_seed_picker.hud_chip: HUD seed chip (data-testid='hud-seed') shows typed label, click copies to clipboard
L2_seed_picker.persistence: seed + seedLabel survive save/load, legacy saves without seed show no chip

L3_live_portraits.animation: Species Database portraits animate idle/blink loop at ~25Hz, pixels change over 1.2s
L3_live_portraits.ticker: Shared rAF ticker (window.__portraitLive) matches mounted portrait count, drops to 0 when drawer closes
L3_live_portraits.optimization: IntersectionObserver pauses off-screen rows (no repaints), first paint unchanged (frame 0)

L4_creature_voices.profiles: Predators snarl, floaters keen, colossi bellow, small animals chirp; bigger silhouettes get lower pitch
L4_creature_voices.cues: Threat display rising edge logs voice:snarl:threat, lunge burst logs voice:snarl:lunge
L4_creature_voices.rate_limiting: Per-animal 2.6s gap, global 320ms gap, rolling cap 3 voices/2s enforced
L4_creature_voices.mute: Muted: cues logged but not played (voices.muted grows), unmute resumes playback
L4_creature_voices.distance: Off-screen animals attempt no voices (distance attenuation)
L4_creature_voices.sim_isolation: Voices never touch simulation state (paused tick + cash unchanged)

regression.ops_deck: Dock/drawer shell, single-drawer invariant, canvas interactivity, HUD routing, legacy fallback all working
regression.art_v2: Cel-shading, rim lighting, halo glow, terrain textures all working with flag on/off

notes: All Phase L features are render/UI-layer only and do not modify simulation rules or save format (only additive state.seedLabel)
No console or page errors detected across all test runs
Backend API scoping with X-Player-Token working correctly
All test saves cleaned up after execution
Ops Deck shell (iteration 24) remains stable with Phase L additions
